queueSource.contract: same-task-thread callbacks execute inline; otherwise graphics tasks enter the queue, so module unload cannot wait on a stopped graphics worker

videoTaskReleaseSource.contract: graphics tasks enqueued after stop_video cannot execute; after module unload the video task deque is freed without invoking the callbacks, so payload ownership must be discharged by the plugin before the queue storage is released

globalSourceRemoveSignal.contract: private sources intentionally omit global source_remove; the private helper removes its retained synthetic source then forwards the same source pointer through the global source_remove handler so the plugin's actual listener queues an event after stop_video without registering an input for frontend cleanup
